description: Get specific, prioritized fixes to raise a website's AI visibility and audit scores. Use this when someone asks "how do I fix this," "what should I change," "how do I improve my AI visibility," or after an audit surfaces issues. Returns ranked actions with expected impact, each built from the domain's latest audit and citing its evidence (blocked AI crawlers, missing structured data, the competitor sites the assistants cited). Works with any Website Auditor API key and needs an audit on record for the domain; with Pro it also says where to get listed, what the assistants get wrong about the business, and which file in the fix package fixes each finding — without Pro the listing places are only counted.
name: get_recommendations

run_id.description: The audit the steps come from.

tier.description: Which list the API served. "free" omits where to get listed, what the assistants get wrong and each finding's fix file; its step marked `locked` only counts what Pro shows.

title: Prioritized fixes
